looks.name: Studio
looks.tagline: A dense, near-black workbench for agent chats: quiet chrome, compact rows, a boxed prompt.

looks.name: Paper
looks.tagline: A warm, roomy reading look for agent chats: serif replies on paper, soft rounded prompts.

looks.name: Cards New Tab
looks.tagline: One rounded field, the project and agent under it, and your three most recent chats as cards.

looks.name: Threads New Tab
looks.tagline: A New Tab page with the field on top, Recently Closed, and every chat as a quiet list.

looks.name: Tachyon
looks.tagline: A modern terminal look: command output as cards, two-tone graphite, a vivid teal, the prompt at the bottom.

looks.name: Kerf
looks.tagline: A fast editor look: tight, flat, one-pixel chrome, One-like slate, a dense project panel beside the agent panel.

looks.name: Prism
looks.tagline: A browser-as-sidebar look: a space-colored frame holding the rows, a borderless card inset in it, playful soft menus.

looks.name: Hush
looks.tagline: A calm assistant-browser look: warm near-white, a large rounded card on a soft shadow, a quiet chat panel.

looks.name: Basalt
looks.tagline: A quiet, near-black agent-editor look: a cool sidebar of repositories, a bordered prompt, steel-blue Run.

looks.name: Linen
looks.tagline: A soft consumer chat look: one centered column, a pill composer, a gray history sidebar, almost no chrome.

looks.name: Docket
looks.tagline: A dense, calm issue-tracker look: a near-black sidebar, one outlined panel, gray text steps and a single indigo.

looks.name: Ember
looks.tagline: A floating command-surface look: dark glass, compact rows, neutral gray selection and one coral red.

looks.name: Folio
looks.tagline: cmux as a document workspace: a warm off-white page, a quiet tree of pages in the sidebar, slash-menu menus.

looks.name: Tandem
looks.tagline: cmux as an agent workspace: chats and tabs in one sidebar, a gray workspace card, the approval policy in orange.
